textos.texto: Good morning! My name is Ana. Nice to meet you. Hello Ana! My name is Paul. How are you? I am fine, thank you. And you? Very well, thanks! Welcome, Ana. Thank you, Paul. Excuse me, Mr Lee is here. Good afternoon, Mr Lee! Good afternoon. See you tomorrow, Ana. Goodbye, Paul. Have a nice day!

preguntas.enunciado: Ana y Paul se saludan por la mañana.
